method_note: Radar constants were taken from Hr-Br_Ver1.0.ipynb; this project continues to use its own joint MUSIC localization and phase-based vital-rate estimator, not the notebook CBF/FFT processing method.
antenna_spacing_assumption: half wavelength at 77 GHz; notebook literal lambda_max/2*250 would be 0.487 m and is treated as a unit/expression error
slow_time_rate_basis: Notebook AutoCorr axis assigns 25.6 s across 512 chirps, implying 20 Hz; not independently verified for RATHAN_WALKING_VIDEO.bin.
rate_results: See vital_summary.json and vital_estimates.csv. Exploratory outputs are not validated.
